task: Set up the dashboard autostart LaunchAgent on this Mac Mini: (1) create ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aiagentsystem.dashboard.plist with Label com.aiagentsystem.dashboard, ProgramArguments running /bin/bash on this repo's coworker/triggers/dashboard-autostart.sh, RunAtLoad true, KeepAlive true, and stdout/stderr logs under /tmp - exact plist content is in Sam's last chat message to Irtiza and in docs/operations/local-operations.md. (2) Load it: launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aiagentsystem.dashboard.plist. (3) Verify it actually stays up: launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.aiagentsystem.dashboard and confirm http://localhost:4317 responds. Note: this is a plain local launchctl call like your already-working check-in trigger - not a cloud Routine grant - but a similar-looking launchctl bootstrap call was blocked by the auto-mode permission classifier once before on this same machine (task ae73c05f). If that happens again, do not work around it - leave this task dispatched (not failed), post the exact block text to issue #1, and say what's needed from a human. The remaining step (pinning http://localhost:4317 to the Dock via Safari's Add to Dock) is a GUI click only Irtiza can do - not part of this task.
